subject: Request: commit-provenance + CD approval evidence for SIG review
messages:
From: security-assessment@trustauditors.com
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: jane.lee@finbridge.com
Date: Wed, 18 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: commit provenance and CD approvals (SIG)

Hi Vanessa,

TrustAuditors is conducting the SIG review requested by FinBridge. To complete our assessment for the Secure SDLC section we need the following artifacts covering the period Jan 1 2027 — Mar 31 2028:

- Export of commit metadata for the main and release branches (author, commit id, timestamp, GPG/signature flag) for the last 18 months (CSV).
- CI run logs showing PR validation and security gating for a sample of 10 merged PRs (include timestamps and build IDs).
- Trace of PR approvals (who approved, timestamps), and any automation (CODEOWNERS) that acted.
- CD approval events / change runbook for emergency and routine deploys (audit trail).
- Evidence of secret-scanning failures and remediation tickets during that period.

Please indicate if any items contain sensitive data that must be redacted and a delivery ETA. If easier, a drive folder with zipped exports is fine. Our preferred delivery is encrypted archive and a short readme mapping files to the bullets above.

Can you send this by EOD Apr 18 (our review kickoff is tomorrow afternoon)? If you need more time, propose a date.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Security Assessment Lead
TrustAuditors
security-assessment@trustauditors.com

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
To: security-assessment@trustauditors.com
Cc: jane.lee@finbridge.com
Date: Wed, 18 Apr 2028 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: commit provenance and CD approvals (SIG)

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the exports and a mapped readme. High-level plan:

1) Commit provenance CSV: we will export commit metadata (author, email, commit hash, timestamp, GPG signature flag) from our Git host for main, release/* for the requested window.
2) CI traces: export 10 merged PR builds (logs + build IDs) with PR validation steps and security scan passes/fails.
3) PR approval trace: PR metadata including approvers and CODEOWNERS entries for those repos.
4) CD approvals & runbook: include our documented emergency-runbook and the audit trail from the deployment system showing approvals and who triggered the action.
5) Secret-scan evidence: flagged findings and Jira remediation tickets.

We have a small amount of PII (committer emails) — we will deliver full exports inside an encrypted archive and provide a redacted copy if needed for public share. ETA: I will bundle initial artifacts by 16:00 PT today and share via a protected Drive link. If you need a DocuSign encryption key exchange, let me know.

Tagging internal owners to assemble: @rishi_malhotra (repo exports and commit signing evidence), @priyom_das (CI/CD traces, runbook, Jira tickets).

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Manager, Compliance
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Apr 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: commit provenance + CD approvals — action items

Team — forwarding Marta's request (below). Short checklist and owners: please confirm when you have each item staged in the evidence folder (link at the bottom).

Checklist:
- [Rishi] commit-provenance-export.csv: include repo name, branch, commit_hash, author_name, author_email, timestamp (ISO8601), gpg_signed (true/false). Include a small README that describes how the export was generated (git log command / API). Also include a note on how we assert commit signing (we don't require signed commits on all repos; mark signed vs unsigned).
- [Priyom] ci-pr-approval-trace.pdf: compile CI run logs (10 merged PRs across two repos) showing the PR validation stage, ssca/security-scan results, and the build IDs. Also extract PR approval history (approver username + timestamp).
- [Rishi] cd-runbook-emergency-change.pdf: latest emergency runbook page and the CD system's approval audit for two emergency and three routine deploys in Q1 2028.
- [Priyom] secret-scan-findings.csv: list of scanner findings with ticket IDs and remediation status.

Notes:
- Redaction: do not include raw secret values. For committer emails — include them in the encrypted archive; create a redacted CSV (committer_id hashes) for the public copy.
- Format: prefer csv/pdf for exports so auditors can ingest.
- Put everything under the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSDLC-evidence and mark folder description with the mapping readme.

Please reply with quick thumbs-up and ETA (I need to deliver to auditor by 4p PT).

Marta — attached are the requested artifacts and a short mapping readme. For large files, I have uploaded encrypted archives to the Drive folder below and included a redacted set in the attachments. If you need the encryption passphrase exchanged via DocuSign, say the word.

Attachments included in this message:
- commit-provenance-export.csv (CSV; full export contained in encrypted archive)
- ci-pr-approval-trace.pdf (PDF; PR logs and build IDs for 10 merged PRs)
- cd-runbook-emergency-change.pdf (PDF; runbook + sample deployment approval audit)

Drive (encrypted archive + full exports): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSDLC-evidence
HubSpot reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/FB-48291

Summary of oddities/limits:
- Our repo policy does not enforce universal signed commits; the export flags signed vs unsigned commits. We have a plan to migrate key teams to enforced signing by Q4 2028 (we can share the migration RFC if useful).
- Some CI logs contain internal IPs; we have redacted those in the public PDF but included full logs in the encrypted archive for the auditor.
- Secret scanner produced 42 findings in the period; 40 have remediation tickets (list included), 2 were false positives documented in the ticket comments.

If you want a 30-minute walkthrough of the artifacts, I can set up a call with Rishi and Priyom tomorrow morning.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
